messages:
alex.ae: Heads up — Skyline demo POC load run scheduled for tomorrow 09:30 PT. We need final confirmation on the load profile, latency targets, and the security/KMS requirement so we can include pricing for Dedicated fallback.

maria.eng: Proposed load plan: steady 120 qps for 15m, linear ramp to 500 qps over 5m, hold 10m bursts x3 with 2m cool-downs. Model: redwood/gpt-small-2048-int8, seq len 512, batching target=32 (max_batch_ms=10). Expected baseline: p50 ~40ms, p95 ~120ms, p99 ~250-300ms in hosted.

chris.ops: FYI network: customer will come from Skyline corp IP ranges, need IP allowlist and 2x public egress subnets. They'll test from 3 regions — us-west1 primary, us-east1 fallback.

alex.ae: Security ask from procurement: key material must be customer controlled if Dedicated. They asked specifically about HSM-backed KMS and audit logs retention. irene.sec, can you confirm what's available on Private/Dedicated?

irene.sec: For Private and Dedicated we support KMS integrations (AWS KMS / GCP KMS) and can do customer-managed keys. HSM-backed options are available via customer KMS. Audit logs: configurable retention, can export to their SIEM. We'll need the customer's KMS ARN and IAM binding.

maria.eng: Small note on model variants: we recommend the int8 build for burst cost savings. If they want lower tail, we can route heavy tails to a slightly larger model variant with higher single-token latency but better throughput. Can set routing policy: prefer low-latency nodes until CPU/GPU saturates then fallback.

devon.sre: Operational runbook snippet (for the load run):
```
- Start load generator at 09:30 PT against hosted endpoint /v1/generate
- Verify p50/p95 every 2m, if p99 > 400ms for 3 consecutive windows then switch 20% traffic to fallback model
- Monitor KV cache hit rate, if < 60% lower batching target to 16
- Collect tok/s and GPU util every 1m
```

alex.ae: Pricing ask: customer wants an estimate for (a) hosted POC only, (b) hosted + Dedicated fallback during demo (8 hours reserved), (c) Dedicated commit. Any quick numbers?

maria.eng: Rough figures (quick): hosted POC token cost minimal; assume 120 qps * avg 300 tokens/request * 40 minutes total ~= 86M tokens -> hosted ~$430 at $0.005/tokenk (example). Dedicated fallback: short reserved window 8h including burst pads => estimate $1.2k for the reserved pool + incremental token compute. Dedicated monthly commit ballpark (small pool) $25k/mo. I can run precise calc with their real prompt sizes.

chris.ops: One enterprise blocker: Skyline legal requires SOC2 Type II and data residency clause for EU users. We have SOC2 but need to add EU-data residency notes for Private. Legal is tracking.

irene.sec: Also need clarity on PI data handling. If they insist, recommend Private deploy inside their VPC — that avoids data egress concerns.

alex.ae: Can we include a sample k6 load command for their infra team so they can reproduce the load?

maria.eng: sure — sample:
```
k6 run --vus 200 --duration 20m --rps 0 --out json=run.json 
--ua "skyline-poc" script.js
// script.js will hit /v1/generate with batch size 32 and seq_len 512
```

devon.sre: I'll add a canary routing rule to the demo config: 90% to primary int8 model, 10% to fallback larger model for first 5m. If error rate <1% escalate to 100%.

load-bot: Scheduled job created: POC-load-run @ 2026-06-18T09:30:00-07:00 (UTC-7) — reminder 30m prior.

alex.ae: Thanks — last open items: (1) confirm Skyline's KMS ARN and IP ranges, (2) SOC2 + EU residency acceptance path, (3) final pricing numbers. Can folks own each?

irene.sec: I'll own KMS question & PI handling.

maria.eng: I'll produce final perf numbers with more conservative p99 estimates and a refined token cost calc by EOD.

devon.sre: I'll own runbook + routing config and be on-call during the run.

alex.ae: Perfect. If no objections we'll ship this plan. :thumbsup:
